flows.name: Create a workspace
flows.job: Start one useful project with explicit context boundaries.
flows.existing: No verified account-backed workspace creation. /platform is a portable editor; sign-in setup is pending in the inspected live state.
flows.mapping: Existing TextField, Toggle, EmptyState; new WorkspaceCreate view and host adapter.
flows.states: Loading: hold name and intent. Empty: try sample without account. Error: inline name/server error; preserve inputs. Approval: invitations and connectors are separate explicit actions.
flows.accept: Submit once, reload accepted workspace, preserve failed input, no implicit connector grant; guest example starts no paid run.

flows.name: Ask and inspect
flows.job: Ask a question, choose a route, inspect the resulting work.
flows.existing: ChatStream and extension Composer exist. /platform has a model-route select for exports; hosted cloud action is disabled in the observed state.
flows.mapping: ChatStream, ArtifactCard, StatusChip; adapt ModelSelector behind authoritative catalog. New ModelIdentity and DraftComposer acknowledgment.
flows.states: Loading: stable transcript and Stop request. Empty: three outcome examples. Error: preserve unsent draft and partial output. Approval: open exact scope before any external action.
flows.accept: IME-safe send, failed-send draft recovery, requested versus actual model labeled, unavailable route explained; never fabricate model/cost.

flows.name: Choose a Star
flows.job: Choose the specialist by the result it can produce.
flows.existing: AgentCard and seven preview crew roles exist. Additional roles are blueprint in the shared roster.
flows.mapping: Retain AgentCard and AgentAvatar. Extend with typed outcome/input/output/availability. AgentPresence is a candidate companion.
flows.states: Loading: fixed-size cards. Empty: clear filters or use assistant. Error: keep last catalog labeled stale. Approval: configure scope then review plan; discovery never invokes.
flows.accept: Stable agentId, repeated cards have unique DOM IDs, unavailable Stars have truthful CTA, configuration survives Back; no personality-based authority.

flows.name: Prepare a workflow
flows.job: Turn defined inputs into a bounded plan before execution.
flows.existing: Live /missions has brief inputs and a plan step for a public Node repository; no generalized workflow catalog was established.
flows.mapping: Reuse mission brief validation, TextField and EvidenceDisclosure. New WorkflowCard composition with authoritative input schema and permissions.
flows.states: Loading: preserve form. Empty: apply labeled sample input. Error: map errors to fields. Approval: review action/input revisions, scope and cap before Run.
flows.accept: Schema validates on client and server, no execution on card selection or model change, unsupported connector identified before run.

flows.name: Follow a run
flows.job: See progress, inspect output, and handle uncertainty without losing work.
flows.existing: Shared reducer, RunGraph, ChatStream and ArtifactCard exist. PR97 Command Center is a bounded local simulation.
flows.mapping: Use existing run reducer and cards. Project timeline from same state; add protocol-backed stopped/unknown states before UI exposure.
flows.states: Loading: queued/running text with last event time. Empty: no artifacts yet. Error: distinguish stream disconnected from run failed. Approval: waiting-for-review is separate from running.
flows.accept: Reconnect resumes by sequence; duplicate events do not duplicate effects; stopping stays pending until server confirms; artifacts stay readable after failure.

flows.name: Inspect research
flows.job: Check a claim against the exact source and keep its limits visible.
flows.existing: Artifacts expose provenance and hashes; ToolResult.sources is URL[] only. Claim-to-locator evidence requires a new shared projection.
flows.mapping: ArtifactCard plus EvidenceDisclosure; new SourceAnchor, SourceInspector and ClaimSupportView.
flows.states: Loading: keep claim in place. Empty: no source supplied. Error: denied/removed/stale source with original locator retained. Approval: new source access needs separate grant.
flows.accept: Citations focus matching source; Back restores reading position; unsupported claim says source missing; retrieved date is not publication date.

flows.name: Project knowledge and memory
flows.job: Carry useful context forward while controlling who may retrieve it.
flows.existing: /platform has context/soul/starlight/memory/evidence files, opt-in local recovery, import/export. Live text says recovery is unencrypted and not account synced.
flows.mapping: Retain portable editor/import/export. Tabs, DataTable, EvidenceDisclosure, Toggle; new access-policy adapter.
flows.states: Loading: do not replace editor text. Empty: add a file or sample. Error: save conflict retains both revisions. Approval: distinguish personal/project/team scope and future retrieval revocation.
flows.accept: Cloud save only after acknowledgment; tab/device/account states differ; scope change enforced server-side; removal explains future retrieval versus historical run copies.

flows.name: Usage and subscription
flows.job: Understand metered use and a plan change before committing.
flows.existing: PR97 UsageDisplay honestly handles unknown values; PricingCard is one-time pricing and CheckoutSummary is a local order specimen. No live subscription flow established.
flows.mapping: Reuse UsageDisplay behavior. New SubscriptionPlan and BillingChange view models; do not adapt one-time card copy by hiding labels.
flows.states: Loading: retain last measured timestamp. Empty: no billable usage. Error: unavailable billing/entitlement state. Approval: effective date, currency, tax and total from server preview before commit.
flows.accept: No invented price, reset date or free allowance; amount/currency/period explicit; denied quota preserves work; pending payment is not entitlement.

flows.name: Capture from the browser
flows.job: Save only the selected page material into the intended project.
flows.existing: Extension sidepanel App/PageAccess and capture-visible, read-active-tab, send-to-mission tools exist in source; installed release not verified.
flows.mapping: Reuse page-access guard, selected-text prefill and ArtifactCard. New capture acknowledgment and deduplication adapter.
flows.states: Loading: one pending save. Empty: select text or use chosen page. Error: access denied/offline queue labeled. Approval: explicit page/selection scope; no background tab access.
flows.accept: Preview exact payload and destination; credentials/query secrets excluded; save success requires receipt; retry same captureId avoids duplicate; queued differs from saved.

flows.name: Capture an idea by voice
flows.job: Keep an idea quickly, then decide when its text may leave the device.
flows.existing: Native mobile is absent from the inspected CLIENT_SURFACES list (extension and desktop only). This is a concept, not an implemented Starlight mobile screen.
flows.mapping: New native recorder/share adapter; reuse token roles, CaptureView contract and destination language. No native stack choice made here.
flows.states: Loading: processing with audio retained until policy says otherwise. Empty: tap to record or type. Error: permission denial offers text; offline preserves local draft. Approval: disclose off-device transcription before sending.
flows.accept: One-handed 48dp controls, stop recording on interruption, permission denied recovery, encrypted local queue and explicit sync acknowledgment; no automatic run.

flows.name: Review an agent action
flows.job: Approve the exact action with enough context to accept responsibility.
flows.existing: Web ApprovalCard binds artifacts and shows replay resolution. Shared RunApproval only has pending/approved/rejected; expiry/revision binding not established in projection.
flows.mapping: Retain authoritative ApprovalCard; new pending-submission/stale/expired/unknown adapter after protocol support. Extension platform decisions may require console.
flows.states: Loading: buttons disabled while full scope loads. Empty: no decisions waiting. Error: submission outcome unknown; inspect same approval before retry. Approval: changed/expired requests cannot be accepted.
flows.accept: Server binds actor, tenant, run, scope hash, revision and expiry; no swipe/notification approval; offline read only; retry idempotent; decision receipt separate from execution result.
